target_customer: Startup talent (candidates) and VC-backed startups hiring
problem: Job search and startup recruiting are noisy. Standout gives each candidate and each company an agent that assesses the other side and only makes introductions when the fit is real.

founders.name: Alexis Aftalion
previous_startups: Zealy (grew to 1.5M MAU and $3M ARR in 12 months per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Another source lists his title as CTO; YC page says CEO.

competitors.name: Jack & Jill
competitors.what: AI career agent for candidates and AI recruiter for employers
competitors.traction_then: expanded to San Francisco in January 2026
competitors.funding_then: reports conflict between a $20M seed and later $40M Series A

competitors.name: Paraform
competitors.what: recruiter marketplace with AI agents for startups
competitors.funding_then: $65M raised to date after Series B

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent chat, matching and anonymity controls are standard LLM product engineering, with some difficulty in assessment quality.

defensibility.rationale: A two-sided marketplace can build liquidity, but similar agent products were funded at the same time and switching is easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No action against Standout reported. LinkedIn launched a Hiring Assistant per roundup sources.

market_need_then: Startup hiring and job search were widely seen as broken, and funded AI recruiting agents appeared in 2025 and 2026, which suggests demand. No Standout traction data is public.

branding.domain_note: Uses standout.work, not a .com; the legal entity is Standout Work, Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions the agent as selective about who it represents.

brand_strength.rationale: The real word is memorable but common, and no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Standout joined YC in Spring 2026 with a founder who previously scaled Zealy and a CTO from Dropbox, Samsara and Chime. It is Active with a team of 7 per YC and no reported funding, acquisition or shutdown. It competes against better funded AI recruiting agents.
notes: Directories list $500K pre-seed or seed, unverified aggregator figures, not recorded as rounds. One snippet says a team of three while YC says 7. Jack & Jill funding reports conflict. The search for shutdown found only unrelated companies. Completeness pass: the May 2026 pre-seed of 500K rests on a single database, VCBacked; one other listing shows 4.0M total raised at seed, which conflicts and is not recorded. Investors not named.
